## Prérequis de connexion\n- Le débogage:
## Connection requirements
- USB debugging must be turned on in the device's developer options.
- Use a data cable (data transfer), not a charge-only cable.
- On the first connection, accept the “Allow USB debugging” prompt on the device.

## Common issues
- “Unauthorized” status: look at the device screen and tick “Always allow from this computer”.
- “Offline” status: unplug the cable, wait 3 seconds and plug it back in.
- Device not visible: check that the manufacturer's USB driver (Zebra, Honeywell, Samsung...) is installed on this PC, or try another USB port.
- ADB or scrcpy not found: Settings ▸ Third-party tools, then “Download”.

## Wireless connection (Wi-Fi)
- Android 10 and below: plug the device in over USB, then “Wi-Fi Pairing” ▸ “Auto-connect”.
- Android 11 and above: Developer options ▸ Wireless debugging ▸ “Pair device with pairing code”, then enter the address and code in “Wi-Fi Pairing”.
